SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-09-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO OCT-25-2021 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ROMANA MARTIN IS PRESENT ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED TAGALOG INTERPRETER KARENINA CASTRO. DEFENDANT ELENA B GUILLERMO IS PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. DEFENDANT PAID $200 IN CASH TO THE PLAINTIFF IN OPEN COURT, LEAVING A BALANCE OF $200 OF THE TOTAL $400 OWED. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $200 (MONEY ORDER/CASHIERS CHECK) TO BE MAILED TO THE PLAINTIFF'S NEW ADDRESS. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE OCT-25-2021 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF COURT CERTIFIED TAGOLOG INTERPRETER WAS DISMISSED. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. COMMISSIONER: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
